_nguon: Stage 4.2 English overlay — 12 Houses & Angles. Editorial draft in the modern Western astrological tradition; no verbatim source text.

whole_sign.giai_thich: Each 30-degree zodiac sign forms one full house starting from the Rising sign — the classical Hellenistic standard, clean at every latitude. The Midheaven (MC) is calculated separately, so it may not fall in the 10th house, especially at high latitudes.

placidus.giai_thich: Time-trisected semi-diurnal/nocturnal house cusps; automatically falls back safely to Whole Sign at latitudes >= 66 degrees.

khong_gio_solar.giai_thich: Without a known birth hour, houses and Ascendant are omitted honestly while planetary signs and the Moon's 24-hour range are shown.

1.linh_vuc: first impressions, personal agency, and physical vitality
1.y_chinh: In the 1st house this point shows on the surface: your manner, how you start new things and the first impression others have of you.

2.linh_vuc: earning habits, material stewardship, and self-worth
2.y_chinh: In the 2nd house this point is about how you earn and keep money and how you rate your own abilities.

3.linh_vuc: everyday writing, study habits, and local networks
3.y_chinh: In the 3rd house this point shows in everyday learning, talking and writing, and in ties with siblings and neighbours.

4.linh_vuc: family roots, living space, and private emotional grounding
4.y_chinh: In the 4th house this point sits in home life, your family of origin and what helps you feel at ease when you get home.

5.linh_vuc: creative play, heartfelt expression, and mentoring younger generations
5.y_chinh: In the 5th house this point pours into joy: hobbies, creativity, dating and how you play with children.

6.linh_vuc: daily workflows, practical craftsmanship, and health routines
6.y_chinh: In the 6th house this point shows in your daily work habits, how you organise your routine and keep up your energy.

7.linh_vuc: marriage, one-to-one business partners, and clear covenants
7.y_chinh: In the 7th house this point shows through your partner, close collaborators and agreements between two people.

8.ten: 8th House · Shared Capital, Trust & Deep Renewal
8.linh_vuc: joint finances, shared obligations, and psychological resilience
8.y_chinh: In the 8th house this point concerns shared money and property, debt, insurance, inheritance, and the times you have to change from within.

9.ten: 9th House · Higher Study, Long Journeys & Worldview
9.linh_vuc: advanced study, cross-cultural travel, and ethical horizon
9.y_chinh: In the 9th house this point points toward higher learning, travel, foreign languages and the beliefs you choose to live by.

10.linh_vuc: long-term career direction, public reputation, and leadership
10.y_chinh: In the 10th house this point appears in your career, social position and how the wider world knows you.

11.linh_vuc: professional circles, shared causes, and long-range aspirations
11.y_chinh: In the 11th house this point shows through friends, the groups you join and your long-term goals.

12.linh_vuc: quiet retreat, releasing hidden fatigue, and inner restoration
12.y_chinh: In the 12th house this point works behind the scenes: when you are alone, when you rest, and in what you rarely say out loud.

asc.bach_duong: Aries Rising: people see you as quick, direct and ready to act; you enter new places through action.
asc.kim_nguu: Taurus Rising: people see you as calm, pleasant and dependable; you enter new places slowly, observing first.
asc.song_tu: Gemini Rising: people see you as lively, curious and easy to talk to; you get to know others through questions and exchange.
asc.cu_giai: Cancer Rising: people see you as gentle, attentive and a little reserved at first; you open up once you feel safe.
asc.su_tu: Leo Rising: people see you as confident, warm and noticeable; you walk into new places with clear presence.
asc.xu_nu: Virgo Rising: people see you as neat, modest and considerate; you connect by helping with something concrete.
asc.thien_binh: Libra Rising: people see you as polite, likeable and tactful; you enter new places with grace.
asc.bo_cap: Scorpio Rising: people see you as private, deep and observant; you keep your distance until you trust.
asc.nhan_ma: Sagittarius Rising: people see you as cheerful, open and playful; you treat new places as an adventure.
asc.ma_ket: Capricorn Rising: people see you as serious, mature and measured; you earn trust by being on time and keeping your word.
asc.bao_binh: Aquarius Rising: people see you as different, friendly yet a little distant; you connect through ideas.
asc.song_ngu: Pisces Rising: people see you as soft, dreamy and empathetic; you blend into the mood of a new place.

mc.bach_duong: Aries Midheaven (MC): suits work where you get to initiate, lead and decide fast; people remember you for daring to go first.
mc.kim_nguu: Taurus Midheaven (MC): suits work that makes tangible, lasting things (craft, finance, food, design); your standing comes from consistent quality and reliability.
mc.song_tu: Gemini Midheaven (MC): suits work with words, communication, teaching, media and trade; you are known for being quick and clear.
mc.cu_giai: Cancer Midheaven (MC): suits work in care, education, food, housing and family-related fields; your standing comes from dedication.
mc.su_tu: Leo Midheaven (MC): suits work in front of others: leading, performing, creating, training; you are remembered for your enthusiasm.
mc.xu_nu: Virgo Midheaven (MC): suits work that needs precision and usefulness: engineering, analysis, accounting, health care, process management; your standing comes from careful work.
mc.thien_binh: Libra Midheaven (MC): suits work with people and beauty: law, negotiation, design, consulting, partnerships; you are trusted for being fair.
mc.bo_cap: Scorpio Midheaven (MC): suits work that goes deep: research, investigation, psychology, managing resources, handling difficult cases; your standing comes from discretion and persistence.
mc.nhan_ma: Sagittarius Midheaven (MC): suits work that widens horizons: teaching, publishing, travel, foreign trade, law; you are remembered for vision and frankness.
mc.ma_ket: Capricorn Midheaven (MC): suits climbing step by step within an organisation: management, administration, construction, corporate finance; your standing comes from long-term responsibility.
mc.bao_binh: Aquarius Midheaven (MC): suits innovative and community-minded work: technology, science, social organising, networks; you are known for original ideas.
mc.song_ngu: Pisces Midheaven (MC): suits art, music, design, social work and emotional support; your standing comes from compassion and imagination.
